Migrate.// Policy: Validate refuses to start while a module context has a pending migration, so a deployment applies them before the host runs, from CI/CD: dotnet elsa persistence apply, then dotnet elsa persistence post-migrate for any module reporting a required post-migration action. Every EF module reads this one key, Secrets included. AutoMigrate hands migration back to shell activation.

Nuplane.// HostProvidedPackages: This file is appsettings.Production.json in a Workbench built with computed package versions, the CI image among them: Elsa.Workbench.csproj ships it in place of the committed one whenever ElsaVersionComputationCommit is set (#2084). It is that file plus this list, which declares the package of every assembly Nuplane:Loading:SharedAssemblies shares, the Elsa ones included. Such a build records each Elsa package in its deps.json at the version the feed carries, so Nuplane refuses a feed package that needs a newer one (host-version-unsatisfied) instead of binding it to the host's older copy. A source build records its Elsa packages at the dev version, which every feed package's range excludes, so it keeps the committed file and leaves them undeclared. The list replaces appsettings.json's entry by entry, so it restates all of them. HostProvidedPackagesGuardTests keeps it complete and keeps the rest of this file equal to the committed one.
